audience: Public Titan Pocket port; broader than the owner's configuration
carrier_policy: Retain compatible stock telephony/IMS capabilities and platform carrier configuration; no owner-carrier allowlist. Report tested configurations separately from untested ones.
language_policy: Retain platform locales, selectable physical layouts and third-party IME compatibility. Do not restrict languages to the owner's initial test language.

initial_language_observation.required_default_replacement: Open-source IME compatible with Pocket hardware and multilingual input; selection pending evaluation

application_policy: Replace OEM user-facing keyboard/settings/shortcut features with appropriately licensed implementations. Review licenses and provenance of every reused source and binary before public distribution.
proprietary_hardware_policy: Keep exact source-version/hash provenance for required vendor HAL, firmware, IMS and TEE dependencies. Redistribution permissions unresolved; do not treat extraction as permission. Provide extraction tooling where appropriate without claiming it resolves redistribution rights.
validation_policy: Stock feature parity is the target; label carrier/region/IME/accessory combinations tested, failed or untested. Physical radio bands and operator acceptance are not expanded by the ROM.
data_backup_status: User explicitly states current user data is disposable; no personal-data preservation required for this test device. Verified stock/calibration/provisioning backups remain required recovery assets.
hands_on_window: Device testing paused at user request; continue offline work and text questions until resumed.

approved_improvements.goal: Reduce measured approximately 0.5-second LED-control onset delay without regressing idle power or ambient-light policy
Configurable cursor movement with clear separation from scrolling and safeguards for normal typing, focus and IME compatibility
Configurable keyboard/button actions with persistence and appropriate keyguard restrictions
